set.body:
Epic: bd-01KXYJK0XSA3RNH9ANMVC96EPE

Replace scalafim.linalg SparseTriplets, CsrMatrix, and generic LinearMap machinery with Gale COO, CSR, and DoubleLinearOperator facilities.

Keep Scalafim semantic wrappers for multivariate spaces, metric roles, evidence, graph bases, and storage policy. Generic composition, transpose or adjoint, batch application, restrictions, and block construction must not be reimplemented under a new Scalafim generic namespace.

Acceptance
Graph-linalg, spatial, multivar MatrixView, and other sparse or operator consumers pass on JVM and JS. Dense fallback remains policy-controlled. Numerical equivalence, adjoint identities, block and restriction shape laws, sparse allocation behavior, and operator materialization boundaries have focused tests.
set.title: Scalafim Gale migration 2: sparse matrices and operator algebra
